reasons: Admitted on the vendor's own fetched documentation; this application has not run a live key gate against this endpoint.
China-region platform: keys are issued by and bound to the China account system and are not interchangeable with the international platform's keys.

admission.citation: https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1823/130079 — Tencent Cloud TokenHub API documentation, retrieved 2026-09-25: one base `https://tokenhub.tencentmaas.com/v1` serves OpenAI Chat Completions (`/chat/completions`), Responses (`/responses`) and Anthropic Messages (`/messages`) with the TokenHub API key; per-token billing. The China site issues its own keys (China `tokenhub.tencentmaas.com`, Singapore `tokenhub-intl.tencentmaas.com`).

replayScope.sourceRef: https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1823/130930 (交错思考, read 2026-10-29): "step2 中输出的推理内容（reasoning_content）用于交错思考的必要信息，在多步调用时，必须回填给模型进行推理，否则将影响效果。" (the reasoning_content is required information for interleaved thinking and must be sent back in multi-step calls, or results suffer); https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1823/133534 (保留式思考): with `tools` present preserved thinking is on by default ("请求携带 tools（工具调用场景）时：默认开启保留式思考"), extending retention across user turns, and "开发者需要将模型上一轮返回的完整、未经修改的 reasoning_content 与工具结果一并原样回填给 API";

continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1823/130930 (交错思考, read 2026-10-29): "step2 中输出的推理内容（reasoning_content）用于交错思考的必要信息，在多步调用时，必须回填给模型进行推理，否则将影响效果。" (the reasoning_content is required information for interleaved thinking and must be sent back in multi-step calls, or results suffer); https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1823/133534 (保留式思考): with `tools` present preserved thinking is on by default ("请求携带 tools（工具调用场景）时：默认开启保留式思考"), extending retention across user turns, and "开发者需要将模型上一轮返回的完整、未经修改的 reasoning_content 与工具结果一并原样回填给 API"; Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.
